integrity.evidence: Analytic three-state Markov generator proof with exact algebraic elimination and a finite rational twofold witness.
integrity.reproducibility: Bundled Python/SymPy checker verifies rational conditional-moment recursions and symbolic inverse identities.
integrity.review_limit: Scientific statements have been reviewed within the same mathematical assessment, not independently certified.

scientific_limitations: Stationary exact one-dimensional position moments only, with known trap relaxation and active speed.
Both internal residence rates are positive and finite; zero, infinite and noisy-observation limits are not addressed.
Global structural identifiability does not assert finite-sample consistency, robust conditioning or statistical confidence bounds.
No thermal Brownian diffusion, correlated reorientation, nonharmonic confinement or higher-dimensional extension is established.
title: A twofold stationary-moment fold and three-moment identifiability in a finite-tumble harmonic particle
